sections.body_md: First test recurring preparation, knowledge, privacy, and capacity observations. Consider Four only as a possible secondary emphasis on personally coherent synthesis; an expressive surface cannot replace the core-first comparison.
sections.title: Start with Type Five before considering the modifier

sections.body_md: Given one uncertain problem, 5w4 may test whether the account feels original and personally meaningful, while 5w6 may emphasize verification, reliable procedure, and risk coverage. Either pattern can reverse with role demands.
sections.title: Compare 5w4 with 5w6 on the same task

sections.body_md: Compare how a person names sources, integrates an unusual perspective, responds when a signature idea is removed, and hands work to a standard process. Record behavior across research, critique, and delivery rather than inferring motive from aesthetics.
sections.title: Observe authorship under revision and handoff

sections.body_md: Confidence should fall when the person readily adopts a conventional method, accepts anonymous contribution, prioritizes reliability over personal signature, or treats an original idea as replaceable when evidence changes.
sections.title: Use conventional and impersonal work as a challenge

sections.body_md: Creative education, disciplinary niche, minority culture, portfolio incentives, intellectual property, grief, or a client brief may produce unusual synthesis. Compare these explanations before adding a wing label.
sections.title: Keep craft and specialization visible

sections.body_md: 5w4 is not a separate type, diagnosis, ability measure, or creativity score. The systematic review found little research supporting wings, so this page offers only a revisable observation hypothesis.
sections.title: Keep the wing secondary and evidence-limited

sections.body_md:
Duration: 5

Context: Across five days, select one research draft, one critique, and one handoff where authorship is visible.

Observable signal: Record source use, unusual synthesis, requested revisions, emotional meaning stated, and willingness to use a standard method.

Page-specific signal: Compare personal coherence with verification and reliability while holding the Type Five core constant.

Alternative explanation: Check creative training, specialization, culture, portfolio incentives, ownership rules, and the client brief.

Reflection prompt: Identify the strongest conventional-work counterexample and revise the 5w4 hypothesis accordingly.
